prompt.name: Mechanized Infantry
prompt.look: A modern wheeled infantry carrier: a sleek, sloped desert-tan armoured body on four large rubber wheels, a small roof-mounted machine gun on a low swivel mount with a slim barrel pointing right, a rear troop door line, three small square side windows, and one soldier in a helmet looking out of a roof hatch near the back, his rifle held across his chest inside the hatch. A broad horizontal band is painted along the middle of the body side.
prompt.team_area: the broad band along the body side
prompt.running_gear: Four large black rubber wheels in a row, each with a lighter grey hub and a clearly visible round tyre, with a visible gap of body between the wheels and no tracks.
prompt.identity: the same body shape, tan armour, wheels, roof machine gun, side windows, troop door, soldier in the roof hatch and red band
prompt.damage_gear: a dented body panel and a scuffed tyre
prompt.damage_gear_critical: a bent machine-gun barrel, a flat sagging tyre and a scorched, dented body
